practicalCriteria: Every one of the 15 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
The due period is a whole number with a one-sentence basis, and every point is sourced before issue
Each check has a recorded source, the date checked and the outcome
The overdue sequence has a day number, a written action and a route to resolve for each step
No lien, judgment, collection cost, attorney fee, annual interest rate or returned-cheque fee from a non-Australian form appears in the schedule
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: not applicable: document-only lesson, no field work
